* '''Original''' (this page): Virtual Set 20 release; card image first published 11 December 2022<ref name="img-o-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual20-Light/large/millenniumfalcon.gif</code> as published 11 December 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/23a3730ee5dc43921699d347d0a1ea05f8f2848a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual20-Light/large/millenniumfalcon.gif holotable commit 23a3730] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref><ref name="cj-o">Players Committee card data, [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/f434d313352448d45db14e080230103c086b1276 swccg-card-json commit f434d31335] (12 December 2022): dating evidence only.</ref>: “May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. Once per game, if your [Reflections II] or [Skywalker] site on table, may deploy Han or Chewie aboard from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While Han or Chewie piloting, immune to attrition &lt; 5 (&lt; 7 if both).” No E mark. No [A New Hope] icon. Margin: “Millennium Falcon”.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Millennium Falcon (V) (Errata)]]): PC errata of 30 December 2024; card image marked E1 published 30 December 2024, and the current [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Set20Type.html Virtual Set 20 card list]<ref name="img-PC-E1-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual20-Light/large/millenniumfalcon.gif</code> as published 30 December 2024: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/9d2c01ed1603f793dc8a0569c99d4b544378da9b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual20-Light/large/millenniumfalcon.gif holotable commit 9d2c01e] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref><ref name="cj-PC-E1">Players Committee card data, [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/c3e8344c98da4264b65cf180188c688d868cda80 swccg-card-json commit c3e8344c98] (14 January 2025): dating evidence only.</ref>: “May add 2 pilots and 2 passengers. Once per game, may deploy Han or Chewie aboard from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. While [A New Hope] Han piloting, Force drain +1 here. While Han or Chewie piloting, immune to attrition &lt; 5 (&lt; 7 if both).” [A New Hope] icon. The PC card data's errata note (errataDate 30 December 2024) quotes the original text. '''What changed:''' The condition “if your [Reflections II] or [Skywalker] site on table” was dropped from the once-per-game deploy, and “While [A New Hope] Han piloting, Force drain +1 here.” was added. The card gained the [A New Hope] icon and the E1 mark.
